selectedBusinessId.description: The business of the session; null when the user has several and must choose.

get.description: Exempt from X-Origin-Secret only for GET: health checks must use GET (HEAD or any other method without the secret gets 404).

200.description: The API is up and the database answers.

503.description: The database does not answer in time.

post.description: Sets the __Host-session cookie (HS256 JWT, 12 hours). An unknown email, a user without a password and a wrong password get the same 401. Counts 5 failures per email and 30 per IP in 15 minutes; only a 401 counts.

400.description: invalid_request: the body is not valid.

401.description: invalid_credentials: unknown email, no password defined or wrong password.

403.description: no_membership: the password is right but the user has no active membership. Also origin_not_allowed: the Origin header is not FRONT_ORIGIN.

429.description: too_many_attempts: too many failed attempts in the window.

post.summary: Define the password with a link and sign in
post.description: Consumes the one-time link token, stores the password and signs in with the same response as the login. Counts 30 failures per IP in 15 minutes; only a 401 counts.

400.description: weak_password: the password does not meet the policy (8 to 128 code points, one that is not a letter or digit); the link stays pending. Also invalid_request: the body is not valid.

401.description: invalid_token: the link is unknown, used, revoked or expired.

403.description: no_membership: the password was saved but the user has no active membership; no session. Also origin_not_allowed: the Origin header is not FRONT_ORIGIN.

429.description: too_many_attempts: too many failed attempts in the window.

post.description: Clears the __Host-session cookie. Does not require a session.

204.description: Logged out: the cookie is cleared with Max-Age=0.

403.description: origin_not_allowed: the Origin header is not FRONT_ORIGIN.

get.summary: List the businesses of the signed-in user
get.description: The active memberships ordered by name and id; empty if there are none. Works with a session that has not chosen a business yet.

post.summary: Choose or switch the business of the session
post.description: Sets a new __Host-session cookie with the chosen business and the same expiry as the current session (the session does not slide). A business of another user, a revoked membership and an unknown id get the same 404.

400.description: invalid_request: the body is not valid (businessId must be a UUID).

403.description: origin_not_allowed: the Origin header is not FRONT_ORIGIN.

404.description: business_not_found: the user has no active membership in that business, or it does not exist.

get.summary: The signed-in user, the role and the business of the session
get.description: Reads the membership again on every request. business has status and expiresAt only for the owner; every role sees readOnly, which is true once the subscription is not trial or active or has expired.

403.description: business_not_selected: the session has no business yet.

404.description: business_not_found: the user has no active membership in the business of the session.

post.description: Sets the __Host-admin_session cookie (HS256 JWT, 1 hour). The body carries the 6-digit TOTP code. An unknown email, a wrong password, a wrong, expired or already used code, and an admin without TOTP get the same 401. Counts 5 failures per email and 30 per IP in 15 minutes.

code.description: The 6-digit code of the authenticator app, as a string to keep the leading zeros.

401.description: invalid_credentials: unknown email, wrong password, wrong, expired or already used code, or no TOTP set up.

403.description: The Origin header is not FRONT_ORIGIN.

429.description: too_many_attempts: too many failed attempts in the window.

post.description: Clears the __Host-admin_session cookie. Does not require a session.

204.description: Logged out: the cookie is cleared with Max-Age=0.

403.description: The Origin header is not FRONT_ORIGIN.

post.summary: Create a business with its owner
post.description: Creates the business in trial (30 days unless expiresAt, which must be in the future), the owner user if the email is new (an existing user is reused and keeps its name) and the owner membership, in one transaction. passwordLink (valid 24 hours) is present only if the owner has no password yet; it revokes any pending link. Not idempotent: a retry creates another business.

400.description: invalid_request: the body is not valid, or expiresAt is not after the current time. Nothing was written.

403.description: origin_not_allowed: the Origin header is not FRONT_ORIGIN.

413.description: payload_too_large: the body is over 16 KiB.

415.description: unsupported_media_type: the Content-Type is not application/json.

get.description: Newest first, with the email of the active owner (null if the business has none). Not paginated: there are few businesses.

patch.summary: Set the subscription of a business
patch.description: Sets the status by hand (no transition is forbidden) and, if sent, the expiry. Without expiresAt the expiry is left as it was.

200.description: The business with its new subscription.

400.description: invalid_request: the body or a path parameter is not valid.

403.description: origin_not_allowed: the Origin header is not FRONT_ORIGIN.

404.description: business_not_found: no business has that id.

413.description: payload_too_large: the body is over 16 KiB.

415.description: unsupported_media_type: the Content-Type is not application/json.

post.summary: Add a manager or crew member to a business
post.description: Reuses the user if the email exists (it keeps its name) or creates it. The owner role cannot be assigned. passwordLink (valid 24 hours) is present only if the user has no password yet; it revokes any pending link. A user who is already an active member, the owner included, gets 409; a revoked member can be added again.

400.description: invalid_request: the body or a path parameter is not valid.

403.description: origin_not_allowed: the Origin header is not FRONT_ORIGIN.

404.description: business_not_found: no business has that id.

409.description: already_member: the user is already an active member of the business.

413.description: payload_too_large: the body is over 16 KiB.

415.description: unsupported_media_type: the Content-Type is not application/json.

get.summary: List the active members of a business
get.description: The owner included; revoked memberships are left out. Oldest membership first. Not paginated: a business has few members.

400.description: invalid_request: the id is not a UUID.

404.description: business_not_found: no business has that id.

delete.summary: Revoke the active membership of a user in a business
delete.description: Sets revoked_at on the active membership; nothing is deleted. The owner cannot be revoked. Like every mutation it requires Content-Type: application/json even though it has no body.

400.description: invalid_request: the body or a path parameter is not valid.

403.description: origin_not_allowed: the Origin header is not FRONT_ORIGIN.

404.description: business_not_found or member_not_found: the user has no active membership in the business.

409.description: owner_membership_protected: the owner cannot be revoked.

413.description: payload_too_large: the body is over 16 KiB.

415.description: unsupported_media_type: the Content-Type is not application/json.

post.summary: Issue a new link to define the password of a user
post.description: Valid 24 hours, and it revokes any pending link of the user. It is issued even if the user already has a password (a manager or crew member who forgot it), except for an owner who already has a password: that is 409. An owner without a password can get the initial link again. No body, but like every mutation it requires Content-Type: application/json.

400.description: invalid_request: the body or a path parameter is not valid.

403.description: origin_not_allowed: the Origin header is not FRONT_ORIGIN.

404.description: user_not_found: no user has that id.

409.description: owner_has_password: the user is an active owner who already has a password; the link would let the platform sign in as them (INV-13).

413.description: payload_too_large: the body is over 16 KiB.

415.description: unsupported_media_type: the Content-Type is not application/json.
